reason: The README describes a DSH skill and Python CLI whose primary purpose is OCR, multimodal image understanding, and conversion of documents such as PDFs and Office files into Markdown; third-party API transmission of submitted content warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本模型提供图片理解、OCR 及 PDF、Office、表格和 HTML 文档解析，并将结果转换为可供模型使用的文本或 Markdown。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding, OCR, and parsing for PDFs, Office files, tables, and HTML, converting results into text or Markdown for text-only models.

capabilities: Reads local text, image, PDF, Office, CSV, and HTML files
Performs local parsing and converts supported documents to Markdown
Sends document or image contents to configured third-party multimodal APIs for OCR, document parsing, or image question answering
Uses configured API keys and environment variables
Stores processed results in a local disk cache
